sections.heading: Find your equipment
sections.body: Use category, rarity, search and sorting controls to find an item. Equipment shows its Rank and Style; select it to review its stats, ownership and available actions.

sections.heading: Equip your loadout
sections.body: Equip your chosen hands, armor, and accessories from Inventory. Equipping updates your active attributes, while Quality, Rank, and Style explain how otherwise similar pieces differ.
